edits.issue: Asserts planner capabilities (reading terms, matching flights to check-ins, confirming dietary notes and table bookings) beyond fact_22 to fact_32
edits.old: Comparing options, reading terms, matching flight times to check-in times and confirming the small things (a dietary note, a table on the last night) are hours of work. A planner does them so you don't have to.
edits.new: Comparing options, reading terms and matching flight times to check-in times are hours of work on top of the wedding. With a planner, you have one person to talk to instead of many.
